name: Eleanor Vance
notes: Living with mild cognitive impairment. Responds best in the late mornings with calm, warm reminiscence rather than open-ended quizzes.

facts.content: Obsessed with her blue hydrangeas and lavender garden bed. Spends mornings tending them with her sunhat on.
Fondest memory is the summer family holiday in Cornwall, walking the coastal cliff path and eating clotted cream scones.
Recently started experimenting with soft watercolor painting of birds at her community centre on Tuesdays.
Enjoys chamomile tea with one spoon of wildflower honey around 11:00 AM while listening to classical radio.

name: Marcus Vance
notes: Pediatric resident doctor doing grueling hospital rotations. Can feel overwhelmed by long calls; short thoughtful texts mean the world to him.

facts.content: Recently adopted a 2-year-old golden retriever mix rescue named Baxter who loves chewing socks.
Big pour-over coffee enthusiast, especially obsessed with natural process Ethiopian beans with blueberry notes.
Just finished a grueling 2-week ICU shift rotation, now transitioning back to daytime clinic hours.

name: Uncle Robert
notes: Retired civil engineer, lives in coastal Maine. Always loves trading stories about vintage tools and woodworking.

facts.content: Currently restoring a wooden 1968 day-sailer boat in his barn workshop for the local harbor regatta.
Harvesting heirloom beefsteak tomatoes from his backyard greenhouse and making homemade spicy marinara.
Taught you how to safely carve cedar whistles when you were nine years old.

name: Priya Sharma
notes: Moved to Chicago 8 months ago for a new UX design role. We promised not to let distance fade our 10-year friendship.

facts.content: Joined a ceramic pottery studio in Wicker Park and is learning how to center clay on the wheel.
Training for the Chicago Half Marathon in October, aiming for a sub-2-hour finish.

name: Arthur Miller
notes: Former high school astronomy teacher who sparked your interest in science. Widowed two years ago; deeply appreciates thoughtful catch-ups.

facts.content: Following the latest deep space telescope discoveries about exoplanet atmospheres with immense excitement.
Plays chess every Sunday morning in the town square with local players.
